instruction: GUI-only requirement: Launch Revit from the Revit shortcut or the provided application launch, then complete the task entirely in the Revit graphical user interface. Do not open Command Prompt, PowerShell, Terminal, Dynamo, pyRevit, macros, external API automation, Python, or any helper script/code that directly generates or edits the deliverable file. Use only Revit native GUI tools, menus, dialogs, model views, properties, families already available in the project, and built-in IFC export commands. Seed create two-level stair model. Open the provided seed IFC from C:\Users\user\Desktop\init.ifc in Revit before editing. The seed file is only a simple editable starting reference; keep useful existing geometry, but it is acceptable to redraw simple walls, floors, rooms, doors, windows, roofs, stairs, columns, or beams with native Revit GUI tools if that is faster. Create a very simple two-storey model with one room named Lower Room on the first level and one room named Upper Room on the second level. Add two floor slabs and one stair connecting the levels. This task focuses on Level and Stair creation. Create real Revit model elements rather than visual-only detail lines or placeholder geometry. Use the Revit Room tool for named rooms so they export as IFC spaces. Save the only required deliverable on the Desktop as C:\Users\user\Desktop\result.ifc using Revit's built-in IFC export. Use IFC4 if the export dialog asks for a setup, and enable room or space export if that option is available. The exported IFC should contain IfcSpace rooms named Lower Room, Upper Room; at least 2 building storeys, at least 4 wall elements, at least 2 slabs, at least 1 stairs; no IfcBuildingElementProxy entities. Other dimensions, exact coordinates, materials, family type names, wall thicknesses, and harmless metadata may vary.
